{{Quote|Serving all worlds polluted by the Empire since the Battle of Yavin|Excerpt from Gandorthral Atmospherics mission statement|<ref name="Arms & Equipment Guide Extras!">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20021017web|text=''Arms & Equipment Guide'' Extras!}}</ref>}}
'''Gandorthral Atmospherics''' was a company in operation during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] that manufactured atmospheric [[Engineer/Legends|engineering]] and survival gear.<ref name="NEGWT">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>

The company was notable for its production of large industrial equipment for [[Terraforming/Legends|terraforming]] operations, as well as personal survival gear such as [[Breath mask/Legends|breath masks]] and other goods for the private sector.<ref name="NEGWT" /> The company apparently took an anti-[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] stance following the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction of Alderaan]] by the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]], and its products were promoted for use on [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] polluted by the Empire.

The company used units of the [[LesTech]] [[M38-series explorer droid]] to test their survival gear and atmosphere breathers on [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] planets with harsh environment.
